_doc: #798 THE PIN: the model files this engine ships beyond ML Kit's bundled ones, each downloaded once by ../ml-models.gradle's fetchModels, refused on a sha256 or byte-count mismatch, and staged as an APK asset under `asset` (lib-apks build.json::android.no_compress keeps .tflite stored, which ML Kit's LocalModel needs). Never committed: the hash is the identity. `detect` is the full-label classifier ML Kit object detection runs on every detected object (CustomObjectDetectorOptions over LocalModel): its labels come from the model's own metadata (`labels_entry`), so a box is named with one of 1000 ImageNet classes instead of ML Kit's five coarse ones. `input`/`output` are checked against the real file by lib-apks/test/test-ml-goldens.sh. A licence and its source are required.

detect.name: EfficientNet-Lite0 int8 (ImageNet, 1000 classes) on ML Kit object detection
detect.licence_source: https://github.com/tensorflow/tpu/tree/master/models/official/efficientnet/lite (tensorflow/tpu, Apache License 2.0); class names are the ILSVRC-2012 (ImageNet) synset words
detect.source: TensorFlow Lite Task Library image-classification example (tfhub tensorflow/lite-model/efficientnet/lite0/int8/2)
